scripts.db:setup: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD createdb -U postgres foodopp_db && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD psql -U postgres -d foodopp_db -f schema.sql
scripts.test:setup: npm run test:reset && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD createdb -U postgres foodopp_test_db && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD psql -U postgres -d foodopp_test_db -f schema.sql
scripts.test:reset: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD dropdb -U postgres foodopp_test_db
